spec_features.spec_quote: we deliberately keep parsing lenient and never inject any emotional content in our messages
spec_features.evidence: Tool results are flat/factual strings: run_tests returns `exit_code=...` + raw stdout (harness.py:135), edit_file read-only rejection is a plain 'permission denied' (harness.py:115-116), format error is a neutral reminder (harness.py:179-183). Parsing is lenient: parse_action falls back to a bare top-level JSON object when no fenced block found (harness.py:55-58) and setdefault('args',{}) (harness.py:67). No emotional/affect text injected anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Realized as the actual message strings the harness emits plus the lenient parse fallback.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Harness messages are dry and factual. We never scold, express disappointment, or inject affect. The only affect in a transcript is the model's own.
